cautions: Near the Oberrasen barbecue site the official route passes under the Antholzer Talstraße (SP44, 90 km/h); OSM maps only a level junction there, so if you miss the underpass, cross with great care.
Short stretches of village road in Oberrasen and Gepaiden.
Tarmac on the Linde lane and village streets, hot in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
